findings.detail: The flagged 15-row set sums to $35.6 million fair value, but the filing's non-accrual fair value total is $23.4 million; Amerijet row 27:17 is an over-included footnote row.
Coupa row 28:7 is over-included in the non-accrual set even though the source non-accrual aggregate is already explained by the rows carrying the non-accrual marker.
FR Vision row 28:18 is over-included in the non-accrual set even though the source non-accrual aggregate is already explained by the rows carrying the non-accrual marker.

rationale: Class 3 row-set/footnote adjudication. The filing has a non-accrual schedule total of $49.2 million amortized cost and $23.4 million fair value at December 31, 2025. The 15 rows in the flagged artifact sum to about $56.1 million cost and $35.6 million fair value, which does not tie to that source anchor. The rows bearing the non-accrual marker tie to the rounded source anchor; the three cited rows account for the over-inclusion and carry different footnote markers. This is therefore a real source-grounded data error in non-accrual footnote scoping, not a false alarm.
